stepTitle: With the same training set, adding more features to Sam's model will not result in higher training loss.
stepBody:
Sam uses the model
$$\hat{y}=\hat{	heta}_0+\hat{	heta}_1x_1+\hat{	heta}_2x_2$$
where $$y$$ is attendance rate, $$x_1$$ is dist from bell and $$x_2$$ is section no.
He then one-hot encodes weather (sunny, cloudy, or rainy) into three new features.
